text: Which triple of axioms uniquely characterizes det: Mₙₓₙ(F) → F?
choices: Multilinear in the rows; alternating; det(I) = 1
Multiplicative on products; linear in the first row; det(I) = 1
Multilinear in the rows; symmetric under row swaps; det(I) = 1
explanation: Row-multilinearity, alternation, and normalization pin down det uniquely; multiplicativity det(AB) = det(A)det(B) is then a theorem. The determinant is emphatically not additive, and symmetry under swaps would contradict alternation.
